yeta.name: Yeta Studio
yeta.about: Yeta Studio is a design and development agency that builds digital products for brands that refuse to leave things to luck.
yeta.challenge: Our own site had to prove the craft: one system for brand, product and marketing, in two themes and three languages.
yeta.result: A token-driven design system and a landing page where every section reuses the same components, light or dark.
yeta.tagline: Our own studio site, built to prove the craft we sell: one system for brand, product and marketing.

about.p1: Yeta Studio is a design and development agency from Argentina. We build websites and digital products for brands that value <serif>visual excellence</serif> and refuse to leave things to luck.
about.p2: Before taking on anyone else’s brand, we had to show our own: who we are, how we work and the standard every client can expect from us.

challenge.p1: An agency site is its first portfolio piece. Ours had to carry the brand — the ✹ mark, the metallic display type, the editorial accents — without becoming a one-off nobody could maintain.
challenge.p2: It also had to work for everyone we talk to: in light and dark, on a phone or a 1920 screen, and in English, Spanish and Portuguese, with the same care in every combination.

result.p1: We designed the system first: color, type, space and motion as tokens, and every card, chip and button drawn once in Figma and built once in code.
result.p2: The landing is assembled only from those pieces, so switching theme or language never breaks a layout, and every new page — this one included — starts from the same parts.
